## Structural map engine: where it lives

**Directory:** `internal/mapengine/` (per README's own architecture table and confirmed by tree listing)

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `internal/mapengine/types.go` | Shared types (`Engine`, `Level`, `Kind`, `Options`, `Result`, `Symbol`, `Mapper` interface) and the **routing logic**: `Map()`, `mapAuto()`, `mapTreeSitterWithFallback()`, `normalizeEngine()`. |
| `internal/mapengine/goast.go` | `GoASTMapper` — uses Go's own `go/ast` + `go/token` to extract top-level declarations (funcs, types, consts, vars) with full multi-line signatures and generics preserved. |
| `internal/mapengine/treesitter.go` | `TreeSitterMapper` — wraps `gotreesitter` (github.com/odvcencio/gotreesitter) with per-language tag queries (`TreeSitterLanguageConfig`, `newTagger`, `symbolFromTag`, `computeTreeSitterParents`) to capture class/impl methods, populating a `Parent` field (e.g. `UserService.GetUser`). |
| `internal/mapengine/regex.go` | `RegexMapper` — line-pattern fallback (`regexRules` map keyed by extension, `matchLine`, `inferName`) used for unsupported languages or as an error fallback. |
| `internal/mapengine/regex_test.go` | Tests, including explicit engine-selection assertions (`TestMapAutoUsesGoASTForGoFiles`, `TestMapAutoUsesTreeSitterForTS`, `TestMapAutoUsesTreeSitterForPython`, `TestMapAutoUsesTreeSitterForRust`, `TestTreeSitterEngineFallsBackToRegex`). |

## How the parser engine is selected per file

Entry point is `mapengine.Map(path, content, opts)` in `types.go`:

```go
func Map(path string, content []byte, opts Options) (Result, error) {
    opts = NormalizeOptions(opts)
    switch opts.Engine {
    case EngineRegex:
        return RegexMapper{}.Map(path, content, opts)
    case EngineTreeSitter:
        return mapTreeSitterWithFallback(path, content, opts, true)
    case EngineAuto:
        return mapAuto(path, content, opts)
    default: // unrecognized value → forced regex + warning
        ...
    }
}
```

When `opts.Engine == EngineAuto` (the default, `"auto"`), `mapAuto()` dispatches **by file extension**:

```go
func mapAuto(path string, content []byte, opts Options) (Result, error) {
    switch strings.ToLower(filepath.Ext(path)) {
    case ".go":
        result, err := GoASTMapper{}.Map(path, content, opts)
        if err == nil { return result, nil }
        fallback, _ := RegexMapper{}.Map(path, content, opts)  // .go parse failure → regex fallback
        fallback.Fallback = true
        return fallback, nil
    case ".ts", ".tsx", ".js", ".jsx", ".py", ".rs":
        return mapTreeSitterWithFallback(path, content, opts, false)
    default:
        return RegexMapper{}.Map(path, content, opts)
    }
}
```

- **Go files (`.go`)** → `GoASTMapper` (native `go/ast`); on error, silently falls back to `RegexMapper`.
- **TS/TSX/JS/JSX/Python/Rust** → `TreeSitterMapper` via `mapTreeSitterWithFallback`, which itself falls back to `RegexMapper` if tree-sitter errors (e.g. `ErrUnsupportedLanguage`), tagging the result `Fallback: true` and adding a warning.
- **Everything else** → `RegexMapper` directly.

`normalizeEngine()` sanitizes any explicit `--map-engine` value: only `"regex"` and `"tree-sitter"` are recognized as explicit overrides; anything else (including empty/unrecognized strings) normalizes to `EngineAuto`. Note there is no explicit `"go-ast"` case in either `normalizeEngine` or `Map`'s switch — the Go-AST engine is only reachable through the `auto` path for `.go` files, not selectable directly via `--map-engine go-ast` (confirmed by reading the code; `EngineGoAST` constant exists in `types.go` but has no switch case wired to it outside `mapAuto`).

## CLI wiring (how a user reaches this)

- `internal/cli/ghx.go`: the `read` command registers flag `--map-engine` (default `"auto"`) at line 211, reads it at line 112, and passes it into `ghxlib.ReadOpts.MapEngine`.
- `internal/ghx/read.go`: `Read()` (around line 187) calls `mapengine.Map(path, []byte(text), mapengine.Options{Engine: mapengine.Engine(opts.MapEngine), Level: ..., Kind: ...})` when `opts.Map` is true, and copies `mapResult.Engine`/`Warnings` back into the per-file result (`MapEngine`, `MapWarnings` fields, JSON-tagged for CLI/JSON output).

## Not verified

- I did not read the full contents of `goast.go`, `treesitter.go`, or `regex.go` line-by-line (only their structural maps plus the specific `types.go` excerpt) — the summaries of `GoASTMapper`, `TreeSitterMapper`, and `RegexMapper` internals are based on symbol names/signatures from the map output and the README's architecture description, not full source review.
- I did not check `internal/mapengine/regex_test.go` bodies beyond function names — the listed test names are inferred to validate the auto-selection behavior but I did not read their assertions.
- I did not check whether any other command (besides `read`) invokes `mapengine.Map` (e.g., codemode `--map` support) — only `internal/ghx/read.go` and `internal/cli/ghx.go` were checked.
- The `--grep` on directories (`internal/ghx`, `internal/cli`) failed silently (tool requires a file argument), so I only grepped the two files most likely relevant, not every file in those packages.
